load_model_mllama: load a multi-modal Llama 3.2 vision model using MllamaForConditionalGeneration.from_pretrained with auto dtype
create_quantization_recipe: create a QuantizationModifier recipe targeting Linear layers with FP8_DYNAMIC scheme and ignore lm_head and vision_model
apply_quantization_oneshot: apply FP8 quantization to a loaded model using oneshot with a QuantizationModifier recipe
dispatch_model_for_inference: dispatch a quantized model for offloaded inference using dispatch_model from compressed_tensors
generate_text_with_quantized_model: generate text from a quantized model using model.generate with processor input tokens
